core.metanarrative_position: Apostolic mission: The Church Begins within the Church, Worship, and Mission cycle

claims.statement: Acts 2 presents hearers responding to Peter’s gospel preaching with repentance and baptism.
Other Acts narratives repeatedly connect gospel proclamation with faith and baptism, while the ordering and narrated details vary across individuals and households.
Taken together, these passages support the lesson’s big idea: Comparison reveals recurring gospel-response elements without forcing every narrative into an identical script.

Within this curriculum framework, comparison of Acts supports believer response to the gospel that includes faith, repentance, confession where explicit, and water baptism, without requiring every account to narrate every element in the same order.
claims.interpretive_hinge: The conclusion is a canonical synthesis across multiple conversion narratives: recurring elements are treated cumulatively rather than demanding that a single narrative contain an exhaustive conversion formula.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not present this framework conclusion as an explicit biblical command or quotation.
